page.overview:
Who is Núneth?

Núneth was a Númenórean woman and mother of Erendis.

Núneth was born to an unnamed minor nobility. She was married to Beregar and they had a daughter they named Erendis. She was seemly wise at heart and gave council to Erendis concerning her love of the great mariner Aldarion.
